attrs.citation: Fazl Barez, Tingchen Fu, Ameya Prabhu, Stephen Casper, Amartya Sanyal, Adel Bibi, et al., "Open Problems in Machine Unlearning for AI Safety" (arXiv 2501.04952), January 2025
hypotheses: none — it is a problem survey, not a theorem
attrs.note: VERIFIED 2026-08-24 by fetching the arXiv record; author list and date check out. READ NARROWLY. It is cited for the claim that capability removal from weights is an open problem, NOT for any specific impossibility — the abstract does not assert one and this ledger does not get to upgrade a survey into a theorem.
attrs.result: Unlearning is not a comprehensive solution for AI safety. Dual-use knowledge is the central obstacle: models combine individually harmless information for harmful purposes, so unlearning that information degrades beneficial uses. Evaluation, robustness and the preservation of safety features during unlearning are named as open.
